item.title: Babble, 2025-08-02, 19:39h
item.description:
I don’t have words
that would express the love-as-verb,
but when I see you how you look at me,
I know they aren’t necessary;
you’re feeling the same way.

fuck
i want to demonstrate the versality
not of the word
